# Dependency audit: TLS stack (2026-11-13)

Source: independent QA run `qa-2026-11-13`, `cargo audit` (RustSec database, 1490 advisories).

## Fixed

`rustls 0.23.40`: RUSTSEC-2026-0285, -0346, -0348, -0349. `crates/buslink-core/Cargo.toml` pins `rustls =0.23.46` (uses `rustls-webpki 0.103.16`, patched). `Cargo.lock` updated.

## Ignored (`.cargo/audit.toml`)

| Crate | Advisories |
|---|---|
| `rustls-webpki 0.102.8` | RUSTSEC-2026-0049, -0098, -0099, -0104, -0382 |
| `rustls-pemfile 2.2.0` (unmaintained) | RUSTSEC-2025-0134 |

Both come only through `rumqttc 0.25.1` (feature `use-rustls-no-provider`); `cargo tree -i rustls-webpki@0.102.8` shows `rumqttc` as the sole dependent.

## Reachability argument

- In rumqttc 0.25.1 `src/tls.rs`, `rustls_pemfile` is called only in the `TlsConfiguration::Simple` branch of `rustls_connector` (CA, client cert and key parsing). The `webpki` reference is the error type for the same path.
- BusLink builds its own `rustls::ClientConfig` (`mqtt/tls.rs`) and passes it as `TlsConfiguration::Rustls` (`mqtt/service.rs`, `Transport::tls_with_config`). In rumqttc that branch returns the config unchanged. `TlsConfiguration::Simple` is never constructed in this repo (grep: no match).
- Certificate verification therefore runs in rustls 0.23.46 with rustls-webpki 0.103.16.

Not verified: the vulnerable code is still compiled and linked, only not called. A future change that uses `Simple` would reopen the exposure, so the call site carries a comment.

## Upstream status

rumqttc latest is 0.25.1 (2025-11-21). No release with webpki >= 0.103.16 yet.

## Removal condition

Drop the `ignore` entries when rumqttc releases a version with `rustls-webpki >= 0.103.16`, then bump the pin and re-run `cargo audit`.

Only `TlsConfiguration::Rustls` is used (service.rs:185). Add the comment and files.
The advisories are handled and `cargo audit` now exits 0. I made no behaviour changes and did not commit.

**Changes**
- `crates/buslink-core/src/mqtt/service.rs`: comment only, at the `Transport::tls_with_config` call. It says we always pass `TlsConfiguration::Rustls` with our own `ClientConfig`, and never `Simple`.
- `.cargo/audit.toml` (new): ignores RUSTSEC-2026-0049, -0098, -0099, -0104, -0382 and RUSTSEC-2025-0134. Each line carries your reason text, and the header gives the removal condition (rumqttc releases with webpki ≥ 0.103.16).
- `docs/security/dependency-audit.md` (new): the advisories, the reachability argument, the date (2026-11-13), upstream status (rumqttc latest 0.25.1, 2025-11-21) and the removal condition.
- `src-tauri/Cargo.lock` now also shows as modified. I didn't edit it, so `cargo.exe check` most likely updated it for the rustls bump. Please include it in the commit.

**Reachability check**
- In rumqttc 0.25.1, `rustls_pemfile` is called only in the `TlsConfiguration::Simple` branch. The `webpki` reference there is just that path's error type.
- A search of the repo's Rust code finds `TlsConfiguration::Simple` nowhere. The only use is `TlsConfiguration::Rustls` at `service.rs:185`.
- `cargo tree` shows rumqttc as the only dependent of `rustls-webpki 0.102.8`. `rustls 0.23.46` uses `rustls-webpki 0.103.16`.
- The vulnerable crates are still compiled and linked, just not called. The doc says so.

**Checks**
- `cargo audit`: exit 0.
- `cargo test --workspace`: all pass, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo fmt --all --check`: clean.
- `cargo.exe check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml`: clean on Windows.

**Not verified:** I did not build the Android target, so the rustls 0.23.46 bump is untested there. Run `npm.cmd run tauri -- android build --debug --apk --target aarch64` to confirm it. I also did not run `cargo audit` against `src-tauri/Cargo.lock`.
